bundle_under_test.verification: in-page fetch('main.dart.js',{cache:'no-store'}) + crypto.subtle SHA-256 inside the browser (not only the server file)

environment.fixture_mode: read-only remote full snapshot; POST /api/sync|/api/sync/pull|/api/sync/delta always answers with the seeded snapshot, client writes are recorded but not applied

browser.system_timezone_override: none - the OS/browser zone was left as is; only the APP timezone was fixed

prefs_preseeded.how: written directly into the app's own SharedPreferences web storage and then a normal reload; the settings UI was NOT used
prefs_preseeded.storage_format: shared_preferences web: localStorage key 'flutter.<pref>' with the value JSON-encoded as a string (quotes included), copied from the existing 'flutter.pref_app_timezone_mode' = "system"
prefs_preseeded.why: the seed tasks are dated with Asia/Shanghai 'today' (2026-11-03) while the browser zone is America/New_York (still 2026-11-02), so the app timezone must be fixed to Asia/Shanghai to make the rows belong to Today; verified visually by the Today header '11月3日，星期二'

actions: opened http://127.0.0.1:18821/ (Chinese login form after the locale preset)
typed username (first fill cleared the field - retyped with click+type and verified the input values)
clicked 登录, then polled in a single eval up to 20s

observed.note: no navigation was needed; the known first-login changed.todos -> force reload path resolved well inside the window

step2_3_reload_timeline.method: normal page reload keeping login/data/prefs; a non-blocking in-page tracer (200ms tick, ~45s) samples the Flutter semantics tree for the two titles/subtasks, reads localStorage flutter.todos and records performance.now(); read back with short evals so no early sample is lost
step2_3_reload_timeline.reproducibility: 3 observations: 13.9s window with 0 titles, then 14.729s and 14.706s to first visible; the two tracer runs agree within 23ms
step2_3_reload_timeline.correlation: the sync response carrying both todos arrived 617ms after navigation start, but the Today list only showed them 14729ms after navigation start (~14.1s later), without any navigation, scroll or manual reload
step2_3_reload_timeline.today_screen_during_window: header 11月3日，星期二 / 今日待办 0 / 0 项待完成 / '今天暂无待办，点击查看或添加任务' / 待办 0 项 (screenshot baseline-today-missing)
step2_3_reload_timeline.today_screen_after: 启动待办验收 1 + 验收子任务 1, 启动待办验收 2 + 验收子任务 2, 2 项待完成 (screenshot baseline-today-visible)
step2_3_reload_timeline.not_done: no Today-filter change, no automatic date shifting, no hidden Dart method, no manual provider load/sync trigger
